title: The Lesser Devil
author: Christopher Ruocchio
review:
3.5/5 sort of skippable but there is some interesting stuff in here. Mainly how Crispin and Sabine view Hadrian and their father outside of Hadrian's POV. Some interesting world building, plot was on the weaker side. Some of the world building I sort of had to suspend disbelief that some of the world religions are actually intact in the way we view them today and was hoping for more changes there.

Maybe will appreciate this one more depending on what's in Howling Dark.

highlights.text: “You know, I always wanted to be like him. When I was a boy. He was always better than me. A better student, a better fighter, a better everything. He could be an ass . . . ” He laughed a little. “But I loved him—love him, I suppose. I don’t think he’s dead. But it did always seem like I was in his shadow, you know?” “I do,” Laurent said, “but shadows shrink in time.”
